DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_report_id as "id", incident_type_id as "incidentTypeId", incident_type_cause_id as "incidentTypeCauseId", affection_stretch_id as "affectionStretchId", location_id as "locationId", incident_state_id as "incidentStateId", incident_level_id as "incidentLevelId", current_user_id as "currentUserId", valid_for_min as "validForMin", confirm as "confirm", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible", generated_at as "generatedAt", last_update as "lastUpdate" FROM rt.ims_incident_reports WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ims_incident_reports (incident_report_id, incident_type_id, incident_type_cause_id, affection_stretch_id, location_id, incident_state_id, incident_level_id, current_user_id, valid_for_min, confirm, enabled, visible, last_update, generated_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextValFromSec{'rt.last_incident_report_id'}, :incidentTypeId, :incidentTypeCauseId, :affectionStretchId, :locationId, :incidentStateId, :incidentLevelId, :currentUserId, :validForMin, :confirm, :enabled, :visible, :lastUpdate, :generatedAt, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.ims_incident_reports SET incident_type_id = :incidentTypeId, incident_type_cause_id = :incidentTypeCauseId, affection_stretch_id = :affectionStretchId, location_id = :locationId, incident_state_id = :incidentStateId, incident_level_id = :incidentLevelId, current_user_id = :currentUserId, valid_for_min = :validForMin, confirm = :confirm, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, last_update = :lastUpdate, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_report_id = :id
